title: Number field
summary: A number with minus and plus buttons, for small counts such as refills, tablets or days supply. For free-form measurements use an Input with a unit.

demos.title: Default
demos.note: Type a number, press the buttons, or use the up and down arrow keys. The buttons stop at min and max.

demos.title: Step and format
demos.note: step sets how far each press moves. format takes Intl.NumberFormat options for units, decimals and currency.
